about_short_description.short_description: RYSE is an IoT company that develops smart shade solutions. We are the world's most intelligent window shade automation platform.

product.name: SmartShade
product.description: A device that motorizes existing window shades with beaded chains, allowing remote and on-device control via app or buttons.

product.name: SmartBridge
product.description: A WiFi bridge that connects SmartShade devices to the internet for voice control and smart home integration.

product.name: BatteryPack
product.description: A rechargeable wireless power source for SmartShade, providing 3-6 months of battery life per charge.

product.name: SmartButton
product.description: A remote control device that can operate up to four SmartShade units simultaneously with a single button press.

product.name: SmartCurtain
product.description: A device that motorizes existing curtains by attaching to the curtain rod, enabling remote and app control.

product.name: SmartLyft Pro
product.description: Motorized hembar system for window coverings relocating the motor to the hembar for easier access and control.
